annotations.title: Mint or Inspect Prepaid Bearer Pass

description: Check balance or mint a 0ms Prepaid Bearer Pass (spass_...) from a single Nano txHash so your agent unlocks hundreds of feeds in <8ms with zero per-call blockchain wait.

passToken.description: Optional existing Silex Prepaid Bearer Pass token (spass_...) to check remaining USD micro-balance or top up.

txHash.description: 64-character hexadecimal Nano ($XNO) mainnet send block hash funding the prepaid pass.

usdAmount.description: Optional target USD deposit amount corresponding to the Nano transaction (e.g. 1.00).

name: silex_session_pass
